Texas school district boundaries (via tigris)

txs_boundaries.Rd

Downloads and simplifies the Census cartographic school-district boundaries for Texas, returned as an sf in WGS84 (EPSG:4326) – the projection web maps expect. The geoid column is the 7-digit NCES LEAID; join TEA-keyed tables through txs_crosswalk().

Usage

txs_boundaries(
  year = 2023,
  keep = 0.15,
  cb = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

year

Census TIGER vintage; vintages lag the calendar year, so a recent-but-settled year is the safe default.

keep

Fraction of vertices to keep when simplifying (0-1).

cb

Use cartographic-boundary (generalized) geometry.

cache

If TRUE, reuse a cached copy when one exists.

refresh

If TRUE, re-download even if cached.

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

An sf data frame with columns geoid, name, and geometry, plus a txschools attribute.

Details

Requires the suggested packages sf and tigris (and uses rmapshaper for higher-quality simplification when installed, falling back to sf::st_simplify()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
txs_boundaries()
} # }
